scientific_integrity: The theorem is proved analytically on all three complete supporting lines. Finite exact-rational calculations are diagnostics, not exhaustive proof. The previously published acute isosceles golden-ratio threshold is acknowledged, not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: Only least-period-four orbits, not basins, higher periods or a bounded-edge variant; priority remains subject to independent assessment.
title: Global classification and longest-side rigidity of four-cycles in the farthest-projection triangle map
